rawEvents.title: Lee County's Red Ribbon Award Celebration
rawEvents.summary: Honoring Lee County's Outstanding Drug-Free Students
rawEvents.description:
FORT MYERS, Fla. — Jonathan Engh, Chair of the Board of Thrive Lee, The Lee County Coalition for a
Drug-Free Southwest Florida, has announced that Lee County’s Annual Red Ribbon Award Ceremony
will take place on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. at the Collaboratory, 2031 Jackson
Street, Fort Myers, Florida.
The event is free and open to the public and will recognize outstanding drug-free students for their
achievements, leadership, and service.

Whether you’re going spooky, sexy, funny, or full-on creative, this is the Halloween event you don’t want to miss in 2026. Grab your crew, dress to impress (or terrify), and get ready for an unforgettable night out.
